messages:
olivia: Heads-up — ran docscan this morning and found 4 dead links in docs/onboarding/runtime-guide.md and one broken shortlink in /kb. Can someone claim a quick fix? I can throw a sed PR if no one owns it.

deploy-bot: docscan alert • 4 broken links found in docs/onboarding/runtime-guide.md: references to https://old.example.com/run-deploy and /short/kv-cache; also kb/kv-cache-troubleshooting.md has a broken image, and docs/tutorials/prefix-caching.md -> 404 on /assets/cache.svg. report id: 6421

mike: @olivia thanks — can you paste the specific file paths/URLs? I can take the runtime-guide one.

olivia: sure — hits are:
- docs/onboarding/runtime-guide.md#deploy-steps -> https://old.example.com/run-deploy
- docs/onboarding/runtime-guide.md#kv-cache -> /short/kv-cache
- kb/kv-cache-troubleshooting.md -> broken image at https://cdn.example.com/kv.png
- docs/tutorials/prefix-caching.md -> 404 for /assets/cache.svg

rana: @mike can you also update the curl example in runtime-guide? it still points at the old host.

mike: grabbing runtime-guide. i'll run a quick sed locally:

```
sed -i '' 's|https://old.example.com|https://api.redwood.com|g' docs/onboarding/runtime-guide.md
```

mike: i'll open a PR shortly — aiming for a tiny patch that replaces URLs and fixes the curl snippet.

docs-bot: docs/quick-fix label applied and issue assigned to mike for 48h.

shelly: i'll review the PR when it's up :+1: also can someone confirm linkchecker CI will pick these up?

mike: yes CI runs on PRs; linkchecker occasionally flakes but we can rerun if needed.

olivia: @rana can you own the kb/kv-cache image rehost? sounds like a CDN rehost + path update.

rana: yep — i'll rehost the image under /static/images/kv-cache.png and update the kb page. PR coming.

shelly: tiny ask — add a short changelog blurb in the PR description so customer docs knows about the host/url changes.

mike: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 — replaces old host links and updates curl example. added changelog note.

shelly: reviewing now :eyes:

deploy-bot: preview build queued. docs redeploy will run after PR merge; preview URL will be posted here.

olivia: thanks everyone. once both PRs are merged i'll trigger the final deploy and mark this thread resolved :tada:
